name: intern-platform
description: Internship discovery, matching, and auto-apply platform for college students.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @intern-platform/shared && npm run build -w @intern-platform/api && npm run build -w @intern-platform/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @intern-platform/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @intern-platform/api --if-present && npm run test -w @intern-platform/web --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @intern-platform/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @intern-platform/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @intern-platform/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @intern-platform/api --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @intern-platform/web --if-present
